sentences.text: S1 stated that the meeting would be recorded in an attendance note and that all information provided would be confidential and covered by legal privilege.
S2 identified the ex-partner as Ryan Hale, stating they were together for six years and split up in August.
S2 stated she still resides at 9 Calder Court, which is her tenancy in her own name.
S2 disclosed a daughter named Mia, aged four, who attends nursery.
S2 confirmed Ryan Hale is Mia's father.
S2 stated Ryan Hale visits the flat every weekend (Friday or Saturday night) since August, banging on the door and shouting through the letterbox.
S2 stated Ryan Hale was away for one weekend in August, which was the only exception to his visits.
S2 disclosed that on the twelfth of October, Ryan Hale put his hands around her neck in the hallway while she was giving him Mia's bag, pushing her against the wall until she could
S2 stated Mia was asleep in her room during the incident on the twelfth of October.
S2 stated her neighbour called the police after hearing her screaming, and the police arrested Ryan Hale.
S2 stated Ryan Hale was released on bail, but the bail ran out and he is now released under investigation.
S2 stated there are currently no bail conditions.
S2 stated she went to the GP two days after the twelfth of October, and the doctor wrote down marks on her neck.
S2 disclosed that on the twentieth of October, Ryan Hale turned up, grabbed her phone, and smashed it on the floor.
S2 stated she told the officer on the case about the phone smashing and had to buy a new phone costing about two hundred pounds.
S2 disclosed that on the third of November, Ryan Hale sent a text threatening to kill her, and stated he has voice notes saying 'I'll regret it'.
S2 stated her friend Gemma told her that Ryan Hale keeps a knife in his van for work.
S2 confirmed she has never seen a knife in Ryan Hale's van herself.
S2 stated Ryan Hale is on the birth certificate for Mia, meaning he has parental responsibility.
S2 stated she works part-time at a pharmacy for about eighteen hours and receives universal credit.
S2 stated she can obtain the bank statements and universal credit statement online.
S2 stated she has a crime reference number on her phone (H R one four) which she intends to send to S1.
S2 stated she has screenshotted the threatening text and voice notes.
S1 requested three months' bank statements and a universal credit statement from S2.
S2 stated she does not want Mia to see Ryan Hale until the order is sorted.
S1 advised that a non-molestation order would forbid Ryan Hale from using or threatening violence, contacting S2, and coming within a set distance of Calder Court.
S1 stated that given the strangulation and threat to kill, they could ask the court to make the order without notice.
S1 stated that breaching a non-molestation order is a criminal offence and S2 should call the police straight away if it is breached.
S1 stated that because Ryan Hale has parental responsibility, the non-molestation order would not stop him from applying for contact, but any contact would be dealt with separately
S1 stated S2 should qualify for legal aid based on the police and GP evidence.
S1 advised S2 to ring 999 if Ryan Hale turns up and to not open the door.
S1 instructed S2 to email the crime reference, screenshots, voice notes, and bank statements by Wednesday the twenty-fifth.
S2 confirmed she would email the documents tonight.
S1 stated she would draft S2's witness statement and send it by Friday the twenty-seventh.
S1 stated she would file the application on Monday the thirtieth if everything was agreed.
S1 stated she would write to the GP for records with S2's consent.
